name: ruflo-workflows
description: 두 가지 영역에 걸친 워크플로 자동화: 전체 상태 머신 수명 주기(created → running ↔ paused → completed/cancelled)를 갖춘 workflow_* MCP 도구 10개(create/run/execute/status/list/pause/resume/cancel/delete/template), 그리고 네이티브 Claude Code Workflow JS 오케스트레이션(.claude/workflows/*.js — agent/parallel/pipeline/phase 팬아웃). Princeton HAL 리더보드 제출용 GAIA 벤치마크 구성 요소를 포함합니다.

gaia.description: GAIA benchmark component — run, submit, validate, and track Princeton HAL leaderboard scores

native_workflows.description: Native Claude Code Workflow JS orchestration — deterministic subagent fan-out via agent/parallel/pipeline/phase, authored as .claude/workflows/*.js named workflows
native_workflows.invocation: Workflow tool — Workflow({ name }) | Workflow({ scriptPath }) | Workflow({ resumeFromRunId })
